bug_semantics: Authenticated Maxun storage and webhook handlers resolved Robot rows by attacker-supplied recording_meta.id (or listed every robot) without a userId ownership predicate. Any signed-in user could therefore read another tenant's full robot record, including plaintext google_access_token and airtable_access_token columns, and could modify, delete, execute, or attach webhooks to those robots. CWE-862 / cross-tenant IDOR; CVSS 8.8; patched in 0.0.42.
flaw_origin: The missing-ownership Sequelize lookups were first written in 7e22582997165bf6b127d2d963bf36896d5014ba when server/src/routes/storage.ts was switched from filesystem helpers to Robot.findAll(), Robot.destroy({where:{id}}), and Robot.findOne({where:{'recording_meta.id': req.params.id}}) with no userId filter. Later sinks (GET /recordings/:id, webhook CRUD, OAuth token columns on Robot) reused that unscoped pattern. A same-day userId filter (4d7ff26e) was reverted 20 minutes later by 4bf496fc; that revert is not the BIC.

reasoning: CVE-2026-56767 / GHSA-44p3-ph5c-h5h3 is a real published CWE-862 IDOR, not withdrawn. Before 0.0.42, requireSignIn storage and webhook routes treated recording_meta.id as a globally unique key and returned or mutated the matching Robot (including OAuth token columns) without checking req.user.id. Attack path: authenticate as tenant A, supply tenant B's robot id to GET /storage/recordings/:id or GET /storage/recordings (full dump), PUT/DELETE the robot, PUT /storage/runs/:id to execute it, or POST /webhook/add to reconfigure it. PR 1088/9b5e35ff closed those sinks by adding userId to every Robot lookup; merge 11db025 is the advisory patch commit and first appears in tag v0.0.42, while v0.0.41 is the unpatched 9a5f98e parent. The BIC is 7e225829, the smallest non-merge commit that first wrote the unscoped Robot.findAll/findOne/destroy queries while replacing filesystem I/O; its parent tree still uses readFiles/deleteFile/getRecordingByFileName, so the vulnerable lines are absent immediately before it. 6b4eb8da only changed destroy's key from id to recording_meta.id; 6817a3c0 added GET-by-id as a new sink of the same pattern; 6f11b69f copied it into webhook.ts; 4bf496fc restored unscoped where-clauses after a ~20-minute userId filter and is a revert, not a BIC. AI is judged only from 7e225829's commit object: human author/committer karishmas6, no AI trailers or bot identity, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
